summary: Russian forces are finalizing preparations for a massive missile strike on Ukraine within 48 hours involving up to 45 Kh-101 cruise missiles from strategic bombers plus ballistic missiles from multiple axes targeting energy and logistics infrastructure. Simultaneously, waves of Shahed/Geran-5 drones penetrated at least nine Ukrainian oblasts on November 19, triggering repeated air raid alerts in Kyiv with impacts reported in Vyshhorod and Darnytsia. Ukrainian forces struck a key logistics bridge over the Siversky Donets near Stanytsia Luhanska and damaged a Russian repair base in Kursk region.
key_points: Russia preparing massive missile strike with 6 Tu-95MS and 2 Tu-160 bombers, up to 45 Kh-101 missiles, plus Iskander, Zircon, KN-23, Kalibr from multiple regions within 48 hours. (Source: @eRadarrua/131698)

Ukrainian air defenses tracking multiple Shahed/Geran-5 drone waves across Chernihiv, Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Dnipropetrovsk, Zaporizhzhia, Poltava, Vinnytsia, Cherkasy, Odesa regions. (Source: @kpszsu/97361, @mon1tor_ua/78428)

Ukrainian forces destroyed bridge over Siversky Donets near Stanytsia Luhanska used for Russian logistics and damaged three Russian aircraft and a repair base in Kursk region. (Source: @UkraineNow/85375)
Russian forces advanced near Rai-Oleksandrivka on eastern front. (Source: @DeepStateUA/24013)
Russian attacks on Odesa historic center killed four civilians and injured nine. (Source: @UkraineNow/85374)
Fifteen of 35 major Russian refineries damaged or halted in November, reducing oil refining by 45% per Reuters. (Source: @UkraineNow/85384)
EU preparing 45 billion euro loan for Ukraine in 2027: 20 billion for budget, 25 billion for military aid, repayment after reparations. (Source: @UkraineNow/85376)
Ukraine's DOT-Chain Defence system procured 1.5 million drones from 300 producers with average 9-day delivery, studied by NATO countries. (Source: @UkraineNow/85395)

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces are finalizing preparations for a massive missile strike on Ukraine within 48 hours involving up to 45 Kh-101 cruise missiles from strategic bombers plus ballistic missiles from multiple axes targeting energy and logistics infrastructure. Simultaneously, waves of Shahed/Geran-5 drones penetrated at least nine Ukrainian oblasts on November 19, triggering repeated air raid alerts in Kyiv with impacts reported in Vyshhorod and Darnytsia. Ukrainian forces struck a key logistics bridge over the Siversky Donets near Stanytsia Luhanska and damaged a Russian repair base in Kursk region.

points: Ukrainian forces struck a road bridge over the Siversky Donets River near Stanytsia Luhanska in Luhansk region, disrupting Russian ammunition, fuel, and equipment transport, and also hit a repair base in Russia's Kursk region, damaging three Russian aircraft. (Source: @UkraineNow/85375)

Ukraine's defense procurement agency DOT-Chain Defence has delivered 1.5 million drones to the military since launch, offering nearly 1,200 items from 300 domestic producers including FPV, bomber, interceptor drones, and electronic warfare systems with average 9-day delivery. (Source: @UkraineNow/85395)
The next prisoner exchange will involve over 1,000 personnel, prioritizing seriously ill, women, and those held longest in Russian captivity. (Source: @UkraineNow/85381)
Russian strikes on Naftogaz energy infrastructure in Dnipropetrovsk and Poltava regions are under assessment by specialists. (Source: @UkraineNow/85382)

Ukrainian air defense units engaged multiple Shahed/Geran-5 drones over Kyiv, Chernihiv, Zhytomyr, Dnipropetrovsk, Zaporizhzhia, Poltava, Vinnytsia, Cherkasy, and Odesa regions throughout the day. (Source: @kpszsu/97361, @mon1tor_ua/78428)

Russian strategic aviation has redeployed six Tu-95MS bombers from Ukrainka airfield to Olenya and Engels airbases, with some already armed with Kh-101 missiles, and two Tu-160 bombers in the Far East will join a massive strike expected within 48 hours. (Source: @eRadarrua/131698)

The planned Russian missile barrage may include up to 45 Kh-101 cruise missiles, Iskander-M and S-400 ballistic missiles from Bryansk, Zircon/Onyx-M from Kursk and Rostov (Millerovo), KN-23 from Voronezh, and Kalibr missiles from Black and Caspian seas. (Source: @eRadarrua/131698)
Russian forces launched guided aerial bombs from tactical aviation against Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @kpszsu/97367)
Russian attacks on the historic center of Odesa on November 19 killed four civilians and injured nine, marking the third strike on the area that day. (Source: @UkraineNow/85374)

Fifteen of Russia's 35 large oil refineries were damaged or forced to halt operations in November due to Ukrainian drone attacks, cutting national oil refining throughput by approximately 45 percent according to Reuters. (Source: @UkraineNow/85384)

Western intelligence assesses Putin intends to continue the war at least through winter, seeking territorial gains in eastern Ukraine while using winter strikes to degrade Ukrainian infrastructure and betting on reduced European support after 2027 elections. (Source: @UkraineNow/85377)
Russian forces advanced near Rai-Oleksandrivka in Donetsk region per frontline mapping updates. (Source: @DeepStateUA/24013)
Ukrainian forces destroyed a key logistics bridge over the Siversky Donets River near Stanytsia Luhanska in Luhansk region, disrupting Russian supply lines. (Source: @UkraineNow/85375)
Russian tactical aviation employed guided aerial bombs against targets in Zaporizhzhia region, indicating continued pressure on the southern flank of the eastern front. (Source: @kpszsu/97367)
Russian missile and drone strikes targeted energy infrastructure in Dnipropetrovsk and Poltava regions, hitting Naftogaz facilities. (Source: @UkraineNow/85382)

Multiple Shahed/Geran-5 drones entered Kyiv region from Chernihiv region via Horodnia, Ripky, Honcharivske, and Slavutych, heading toward Kyiv and Boryspil districts. (Source: @kpszsu/97361, @eRadarrua/131705)

Russian strategic bombers redeployed from Ukrainka (Amur region) to Olenya (Murmansk) and Engels (Saratov) airbases, positioning for missile launches against northern and central Ukraine. (Source: @eRadarrua/131698)
Ballistic missile threats from Bryansk (Iskander-M/S-400), Voronezh (KN-23), and Kursk (Zircon/Onyx-M) regions directly threaten Kyiv and Poltava regions. (Source: @eRadarrua/131698)

Air raid alerts sounded repeatedly in Kyiv throughout November 19 as drones approached from Chernihiv, Cherkasy, and southern directions. (Source: @eRadarrua/131700, @eRadarrua/131707, @eRadarrua/131717)
Russian forces launched three strikes on Odesa's historic center on November 19, killing four civilians and injuring nine. (Source: @UkraineNow/85374)
Shahed/Geran-5 drones launched from the Black Sea targeted Odesa region, specifically Zatoka area, and from occupied Zaporizhzhia toward occupied Kherson. (Source: @kpszsu/97378, @mon1tor_ua/78428)
Ukrainian drones attacked the Crimean Bridge again, continuing pressure on Russian logistics across the Kerch Strait. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/78431)
Russian guided aerial bombs struck Zaporizhzhia region from tactical aviation. (Source: @kpszsu/97367)
Ukrainian strikes damaged a Russian repair base in Kursk region, extending reach into Russian rear areas. (Source: @UkraineNow/85375)
